sources.title: Golisopod ex Swing and Skedaddle
sources.supports: After damage, discard one attached Energy, then switch to the Bench.

sources.title: Golisopod ex FAQ
sources.supports: With no Bench, deal damage and discard, then finish. With a Bench, switching is mandatory; effects prohibiting retreat do not prevent switching.

sources.title: Galvantula Discharge
sources.supports: Discard the attached specified Energy and count discarded cards, at 50 damage each; the Lightning type comes from local original English sprite text.

sources.title: Great Ball
sources.supports: Look only at the top seven, optionally reveal one Pokemon and take it, shuffle the rest back.

sources.title: Quagsire Wash Out
sources.supports: Unlimited transfer of one attached Water Energy from own Bench to own Active; Water type retained from local English sprite text.

sources.title: Piloswine Rest
sources.supports: Apply sleep to the attacker, then heal 90 from that attacker.

sources.title: Mega Floette ex Gentle Light
sources.supports: Heal 30 from every Pokemon on both fields.

sources.title: Claydol Devolution Ray
sources.supports: Deal 50 then remove the top Evolution card from the defending evolved Pokemon into its owners hand.

sources.title: Devolution FAQ
sources.supports: Attachments remain. A damage reaction Ability removed by devolution does not trigger after Devolution Ray; KO from remaining damage after HP reduction is not attack-damage KO.

sources.title: Bewear Hyper Lariat
sources.supports: Flip twice; add 100 only if both coins are heads.

sources.title: Armarouge Fire Off
sources.supports: Unlimited own-Bench to own-Active Fire Energy transfer; the type comes from the local original English sprite text.

sources.title: Quagsire Special Energy FAQ
sources.supports: Wash Out may move Rainbow Energy because it supplies Water while attached.

scope: 57 newly supported components (42 attacks, 7 abilities, 8 Trainers), 56 fully supported cards.
boundaries: Only complete recognized clauses are mapped; unresolved components keep whole cards unsupported.
Discard-count damage uses actual cards discarded before damage, not supplied Energy units.
Switch after one Energy discard is mandatory when possible, but no Bench still allows damage and discard.
Whole-field heal covers both players; Rest refers to the same attacker.
Attached typed Energy moves include qualifying Special Energy, use only own Bench sources and own Active destination, and do not consume the manual attachment.
Top-deck inspection takes the window before filtering and permits zero selection, with reveal acknowledgement and shuffle.
